name: fuseway
description: @fuseway chat participant: gives every request a role (planner, builder, debugger, reviewer, explainer) and sends it to the Claude or OpenAI model that role suits. Optional local model first.

chatParticipants.name: fuseway
chatParticipants.description: Plans, builds, debugs, reviews or explains, each with the Claude or OpenAI model that suits it

commands.name: plan
commands.description: Planner: Design, architecture and plans, before any code (read-only)

commands.name: debug
commands.description: Debugger: Bugs, errors, failing tests and crashes

commands.name: review
commands.description: Reviewer: Code review, critique and second opinions (read-only)

commands.name: explain
commands.description: Explainer: Questions about how the code works (read-only)

commands.name: build
commands.description: Builder: Everything else: implement, change and fix

commands.name: grok
commands.description: Use the official Grok Build CLI and its configured authentication

commands.name: usage
commands.description: Show subscription windows and fuseway's recent calls

commands.name: stats
commands.description: How the routers and agents are scoring, and who decides now

commands.name: version
commands.description: Show the installed Fuseway build and workspace Git state without an agent

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show Fuseway setup, model and subscription status without an agent

commands.name: company
commands.description: Run an owner-configured agent company: init, status, run, challenge, stop

enumDescriptions: roles until a local model is set up with Fuseway: Set Up Local Model, then local-first
Each role picks Claude or Codex and its model. No local model, no paid routing calls.
The local model takes what it can; Claude Haiku double-checks; frontier work goes to Claude or Codex by headroom.
fuseway.routing.description: How @fuseway picks a backend. Every mode gives each request a role, whose instructions and read-only setting apply.

fuseway.allowEdits.description: Let backends edit files in the workspace. Off: Claude runs in plan mode and Codex read-only.

fuseway.claudeModel.description: Claude model in local-first mode. In roles mode each role picks its own (roles.json; a repo can change it in .agents/routing.json).

fuseway.codexEffort.description: Codex reasoning effort in local-first mode. In roles mode each role picks its own.

fuseway.frontier.description: balance: in roles mode, use each role's preferred provider; in local-first mode, send frontier work to whichever subscription has more room left after its reserve, counting its 5-hour and weekly windows. Either way a provider out of room hands over to the other. claude or codex: always prefer that one. grok explicitly selects Grok Build; its quota is not part of automatic balancing.

fuseway.claudeReserve.description: Share of Claude's 5-hour and weekly windows kept for your own Claude Code sessions. Headless calls share those windows with you; once only this much is left, @fuseway sends frontier work to Codex.

fuseway.codexReserve.description: Share of Codex's windows kept for your own Codex sessions.

fuseway.learning.enabled.description: Local-first mode only: Score routers and agents from outcomes in the background, and switch to a better decision maker when the evidence is clear. Everything stays in ~/.local/state/fuseway/learning.jsonl on this machine.

fuseway.learning.dailyPaidTokens.description: Most Claude tokens per day the background learner may spend testing paid routers (about 1K per Haiku check). 0 tests only free ones.

fuseway.codexModel.description: Optional Codex model ID. Empty uses the Codex CLI default. Replies report the observed model, or unknown if unavailable.

fuseway.grokModel.description: Optional Grok model ID. Empty uses the Grok Build CLI default. Replies report observed model IDs. Use grok models to list models.
